notes.title: Magic, Maces and Mange Update!
notes.content:
In a free update, Magic, Maces and Mange adds 5 brand-new weapons to Hotel R’n’R - Rockstar Simulator, each with their own unique characteristics, new challenges, additional achievements and fancy-upgraded versions to add to your Rider loadout! The update also contains a secret upgrade to the fire crackers and a chance of picking up the new items in the hotel safes.

Along with this we've added numerous PC improvements.

[b]Full patch notes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fight back against the security guard
[*] 4 brand new Weapons, Magic Wand, Bullet-Mace, Pocket-Pal and Taser Gun
[*] 12 new challenges and upgraded versions of each new weapon
[*] 5 New Achievements
[*] 1 hidden upgrade that reveals a whole new weapon with it’s own mechanics and interactions
[*] New weapons added as Safe items, even the number of the beast!
[*] Applied explosive damage to the manager, plant a C4 at his feet and find out
[*] Fixed fire system, if it looks like it should burn, it will, also try the Oil spray + lighter
[*] Improved electricity system, Cattle-Prod and Taser Gun can cause massive explosions. Hold to overcharge electrical objects
[*] Remodeled character art and increased texture resolution throughout
[*] Improved lighting and FX throughout
[*] Additional achievements
[*] Improved interface and prompts
[*] Added Quest UI for people playing via Quest Link
[/list]
[b]Small tweaks[/b]
[list]
[*] Reduced load times and added numerous optimisations
[*] Added hot barrel glow to the Tac-10+
[*] Reduced cost of Bowling Ball Arm in Pawn Store
[*] Reduced upgrade challenge of Foam Finger
[*] Reduced upgrade challenge of Cattle-Prod
[*] Reduced damage needed on Charity Auction ‘Service Please’ challenge to $700
[*] Re-ordered the setlists to put a more unique and exciting one to the first page
[/list]

Follow us for updates and info about whats happening with Hotel RnR and our other titles:
https://www.tiktok.com/@wolfandwood.co
https://www.instagram.com/wolfandwoodtm/
https://www.threads.net/@wolfandwoodtm
https://x.com/wolfandwood

notes.title: Full Release v1.0 Out NOW
notes.content:
Hotel R'n'R is officially open! Look out for an update to v1.0.

[previewyoutube=MhDnuskHEb8;full][/previewyoutube]

New in v1.0 - List that we can remember doing but there's more

[h3]New Hotel![/h3]
There’s a big event coming, yes it’s The Dolphin and Monkey Mincemeat companies annual Charity Auction and you’re hosting - they could probably do with a hand setting up.

[h3]New Mini-game[/h3]
Ever wanted to live out the Street Fighter II fantasy? Well, The Devil has a serious case of Envy.

[h3]New Setlists[/h3]
Doubled the Setlists, 10 now available with several completely new mini-games specially designed for Setlist competition.

[h3]New weapons![/h3]
A fully automatic submachine gun. The modern art paint job tries to disguise that fact but it is pretty dangerous. The Cattle prod - A mix of melee and handheld explosive, the standard electrical current holds 6 charges and will break most items, but when applied to electronics things really pop. 

[h3]Weapon upgrades[/h3]
New challenges that unlock upgraded attributes, skins and even new features! Laser sights and silencers are just cool!

[h3]Selfi-cam[/h3]
Take pictures, share them via social integration and even share a 3rd person view of your shenanigans on screen! 

[h3]Balancing[/h3]
I covered this in more detail in the previous post but easier to tool up and easier to progress.

[h3]Player looks[/h3]
Yeah the brown-haired-male lead is a Video Game cliche so we added more customisation on your look, different sexes, skin tones and hairstyles, all as arrogant as the next. Not enough games have face tattoos on their lead character - looking at you Nathan Drake.

[h3]Vacuum robot in The Loco Lounge[/h3]
He’ll clean up after you which is nice, sometimes he’ll break things by accident, stupid but cute.

[h3]Quality of life:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Prop hunt UI - highlight shader
[*] Microwave functionality
[*] Death doesn’t slow movement so you have a chance to escape before kicking it.
[*] Additional animations
[*] Playable instruments
[*] Throwable kegs and TVs
[*] Optimisations
[*] Bugs destroyed / improved leaderboards
[/list]

[h2]Not to forget that a lot happened in Early Access![/h2]

[i][h3]Opened the Firing Range:[/h3]
The firing range officially opened in the store. A new place to test out weapons, three rounds of pop-up dummies and a scoreboard.

[h3]Added Party Mode:[/h3]
5 Setlists to be played with friends as Pass and Play or  Solo against the world in Global Leaderboards.

[h3]Player customisation with Hats’n’Tats![/h3]
A range of looks featuring facial tattoos, nose piercings and the odd quiff.

[h3]Introduced Vanity Items upgrades:[/h3]
Skull Rings, a Bandoleer and a Jock Strap all offer health or performance upgrades in addition to the cosmetic benefits.

[h3]New weapons / enhancers:[/h3]
Do not disturb: to buy you some more time
Antic-ide: Crazy liquid sword enhancer

WRM Support and various quality of life updates.[/i]

[b]- We hope you enjoy destroying it as much as we've enjoyed making it! 

Stay in touch,

Everyone at Wolf & Wood.[/b]

notes.title: Hotel R’n’R v1.0 coming 28th May
notes.content:
The world went and changed quite a bit we’ve kept the course and have [b]v1.0 of Hotel R’n’R coming on the 28th May[/b]! A little later than expected but the upheaval of moving to our home offices, mine is mainly made out of garden furniture, has given us time to add a couple more bits of polish and a couple of surprises that might not have made it in otherwise.

[previewyoutube=MhDnuskHEb8;full][/previewyoutube]

Mentioned in previous posts we have some new features, levels and rebalancing. 
[b]Here’s a run down:[/b]
[list]
[*] Brand New Hotel - Charity Auction
[*] New Mini-game - Envy
[*] Sandbox Mode
[*] New Weapons - Tac-10 and Cattle prod
[*] Weapon Challenges
[*] More Setlists, with new games
[*] Balancing difficulty and grind
[*] More character styles
[*] Selfi-Cam
[*] Robot Vacuum
[*] A long list of general improvements
[/list]

[previewyoutube=AFYgnivRb7M;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]There’s too much to reasonably fit into 1 post, so there will be more info and news to come about the other points over the next 12 days as we lead up to launch. 

Follow us on Twitter for smaller  updates in the meantime! [url=https://twitter.com/wolfandwood]Wolf & Wood Twitter[/url] [/h3]

[h2]Balancing / item strength[/h2]
We’ve heard that a few people have found the game to grind and that it can be hard early game to get smashing (we understand that not everyone is as burley as us games devs) so we’ve done lot to answer this:
[list]
[*] Weapons are much cheaper now, so you can get to the next tier very quickly
[*] We’ve added more Challenges so you can get more bonus cash
[*] Early in the game Safe codes are handed to you every few rounds without the need to win them in Mini-games
[*] The chance of getting a really overpowered safe item is now much higher, some are Really overpowered too
[*] We made it a easier to break items, especially early in the game
[*] The Jockstrap is even cheaper, so you can quickly gain a health boost
[*] The new hotel means that there’s more ways to get Infamy and increase the cash multiplier early on
[/list]

[h2]More character styles[/h2]
Yeah the brown-haired-male lead is a Video Game cliche so we added more customisation on your look, different sexes, skin tones and hairstyles, all as arrogant as the next. Not enough games have face tattoos on their lead character - looking at you Nathan Drake.

[h2]Wiki[/h2]
We’ll have a very comprehensive Wiki page for Hotel R’n’R that will be ready in the build up to v1.0. There will be plenty of insider tips and tricks for anyone looking to get the most out of each hotel.

Thanks, W&W team.

notes.title: Double guns! New player upgrades, enhancer and a “Do not disturb” sign.
notes.content:
[h1][b]New Vanity Items[/b][/h1]
The new Vanity Items offer a range of health and performance upgrades that can be equipped in addition to the Rider items. A new “Vanity” slot is available and any of the following can be used to supplement your preferred rider setup. They also look cool.

[b]Jockstrap - Damage resistance[/b]
Protection cup offers 30% extra player health, how? Probably a confidence thing.
Cost: $640

[b]Fancy Rings - Punch harder[/b]
A selection of pawned wedding rings, each tells a story that we don’t have time for. 25% increase in punch power and durability. 
Cost: $1,590

[b]Skull Ring - Increased weapon durability [/b]
Wanna look like a badass-pirate-biker? You need a Skull Ring! Oh and all rider melee weapons take 30% more damage.
Cost: $14,710

[b]Bandoleer - Double guns![/b]
As seen on the catwalks of Paris and every good spaghetti western, the Bandoleer doubles any guns in your rider. Weapons affected: Antique pistol, Revolver and Shotgun.
Cost: $24,860

[h1][b]New rider items[/b][/h1]
[b]Do not disturb [/b]
Now available in Pawn to Die, the “Do not disturb” sign will stop the maid from attempting to enter the suite. You’re free to continue your rampage, she will simply see the homemade sign and turn back without trying the locks. 
Cost: $2,350

[b]Antic-ide[/b]
Enter the Antic-ide, an enhancer that grants you a magic sword and super-slow-mo time, anything the sword touches immediately breaks with a blast of 1970s kung-fu action. It’s OP but the price tag reflects that. We’ve halved the cost of the mind control enhancer, Mindylphen, to balance it out.
Cost: $42,010

[b]Goth look[/b]
Is your soul filled with ravens and darkness, is your real name Brian? This could be the look for you.
Cost $1,000

[h1][b]Updates[/b][/h1][list]
[*] Additional improvements to the Pride mini-game scoring.
[*] Optimisations for the Black Hole performance.
[*] Removed old system for connecting Valve controllers and replaced with a new and improved one - you are not required to be switch the controllers on at the start and the check is optimised, this will aid performance for all SteamVR users.
[*] Hotel rider is now cycled through by touch and punch rather than hover and press.
[*] Reduced threshold for safe codes to 40% for people with Infamy above 6.
[*] General bug fixes.
[/list]

[h1][b]What next?[/b][/h1]
We’re working on a big update called “Party Mode”, an arcade mode that will have “Setlist” groups of challenges which can be played in a group pass-and-play or solo with global leaderboards for each set.

Each Setlist will be a group of different challenges between different hotels, there will be timed or weapon specific challenges that don’t have the usual Maid, Manager and Security routine. The challenges will use a mixture of all weapons, enhancers and modifiers even if you don’t have them unlocked in World Tour and we plan to create a starter set so that it is quick and easy to get friends and family involved.

Along with leaderboards for Setlists we’re looking into leaderboards for each hotel, there is a lot to consider but we’ll keep the discussions up to date with progress.

notes.title: Firing Range and a new wardrobe!
notes.content:
[b]WMR now supported![/b]

[b]Firing Range:[/b]
The firing range is officially open in the store. A new place to test out weapons, three rounds of pop-up dummies and a scoreboard.

[b]T-Shirt cannon supercharged:[/b]
The T-Shirt cannon is a much more formidable weapon. More power, better handles items, especially the powerball and beer cans.

[b]Hats’n’Tats![/b]
We created 4 additional looks for your character, each around different musical subcultures that we’re fans of at Wolf & Wood: 
[list]
[*] Smash it up! A Punk from the Kings Road in London
[*] The man in black, a tight Rockabilly quiff and black shirt.
[*] The dirt, a pure 80s Metal look with headband and 
[*] Lil’Rapper, complete with facial tattoos. 
[/list]
They’re purely for vanity and you can pick them up in Pawn-to-die for a very reasonable $1,000. 

Along with this we’ve been working on additional features and improvements for the fire system, the oil spray now allows you to instantly light items

General improvements and minor bug fixes.

notes.title: Hotel R'n'R is LIVE!
notes.content:
Most of you know that by now! But it is, we worked hard to resolve the day one issues and now we are happy to say... Hotel R'n'R is LIVE! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34282951/efaa2a3839e446d7cf7fb1e024011ad6876cecd9.png[/img]

There is more to come, this is an Early Access launch and we have new systems and ideas we'd like to introduce but it relies on your feedback as we go. like "Big Brother" in 1984, we're always watching, be it comments, streams or let's play, we're paying attention and taking note. From wanting to stab the sausage with a fork to how the levels are balanced we're there.

We'll post a bit of info when we've had some sleep but for now, enjoy!

Patch notes:
- Added Index support
- Tightened up Oculus Touch grip/release
- Index Controller snap turn
- Oculus default controls 

Roadmap:
- Full details to come but we're planning to open up the firing range to make weapon testing that bit more fun!

Hope you enjoy, 

Ryan
